# Beauty on the Lane

> Independent beauty salon in Bromborough, Wirral: Dermalogica & Elemis facials, massage, gel nails, lashes, waxing & spray tans. Call 0151 343 0877 to book.

Beauty on the Lane is a single-page brochure website for the salon at 8 Allport Lane, Bromborough, Wirral, CH62 7HP, UK. Opening hours: Tuesday, Thursday & Friday 9am–5pm · Wednesday 9am–8pm · Saturday 9am–4pm · Closed Monday & Sunday. Phone: 0151 343 0877 · WhatsApp: +44 7742 014037 · Email: beautyonthelanewirral@gmail.com.

## Pages

- [Home](https://beautyonthelane-wirral.co.uk/): About the salon, full treatment & price list (massage, dermalogica facials, elemis facials, dermaplaning, manicure & pedicure, gel bottle polish, builder gel (biab), spray tan (vita liberata), eye treatments, waxing), and a contact form.

## Notes

- This site does not use cookies, analytics, or third-party tracking.
- Full page content is also available at [/llms-full.txt](https://beautyonthelane-wirral.co.uk/llms-full.txt).
